svg.text: A snapshot covers one disk: repeat for each data disk and attach the resulting disks in stage 3.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: With -CreateOption Attach no first-boot provisioning runs, so the clone keeps the source hostname, SID and credentials.

svg.text: its trust relationship. Keep the clone on an isolated
